name: Build Compliant Prospect List
summary: Build a bounded B2B prospect list from lawful sources, explicit fit rules, and traceable evidence.
description: Build or review a B2B prospect list using a defined ideal-customer situation, lawful public business sources, explicit qualification, provenance, minimization, and suppression. Use before approved outbound work when target accounts require evidence rather than bulk contact collection.
refuses: It does not harvest private contact details, bypass logins, infer protected traits, or buy unverifiable lists.
It does not contact prospects, enrich identities, or upload data to another service without authority.
It does not present a fit score as consent, intent, or permission to send outreach.
